thread:
maria: Quick drop - goliath-xl weights uploaded to s3://rwd-models/goliath-xl/v1 (sharded, 16 files). Need a fast tokenizer + seqlen/KV memory sanity before we flip staging.
ajay: thanks. can you paste model config or key fields? max_position_embeddings and kv format matter for our floorplan.
maria: config excerpt: {\"vocab_size\":50288, \"max_position_embeddings\":65536, \"kv_cache_format\":\"packed_v2\"}
kevin: packed_v2 is compatible with our runtime path. confirm shards named like shard_00.pt..shard_15.pt and metadata.json present.
sophie: ran a quick tokenizer pass on sample docs. avg token expansion ~1.18x but some long CJK spans cause tails that spike tokens. also tokenizer injects <|pad|> for short prompts in a few cases.
ajay: that expansion + pad tokens will increase KV. rule of thumb: KV size scales with seq_len * per-token-kv. we should get exact mem-floorplan from profiler on A100-80.
kevin: queued mem-floorplan run. will use bs=1 and bs=2 for comparisons. Also checking whether kv_format packed_v2 increases CPU mem overhead for deserializing shards.
maria: validator to run locally if helpful:\n```\nrwdctl model validate --model-dir s3://rwd-models/goliath-xl/v1 \\\n  --expect max_ctx=65536 --expect kv_format=packed_v2\n``` 
ajay: I'll update the serving config PR with max_context_tokens:65536 and add a fallback policy to reduce max_context to 49152 if mem headroom < 20%.
sophie: tokenizer note: we should strip <|pad|> for client-side short prompts. I'll add a small preproc snippet to onboarding doc and a unit test.
deploy-bot: deployment-checker: shards present (16), metadata.json present, checksums ok :white_check_mark:
kevin: mem-floorplan output (quick paste):
- bs=1 seq=65536 peak_gpu_alloc ~31.2GB
- bs=2 seq=65536 peak_gpu_alloc ~62.1GB (includes KV ~34.1GB)
Est overhead (cuda runtime + allocator + model buffers) ~6GB. On A100-80 this is borderline but under device mem. On 40GB devices will OOM.
ajay: good numbers. for hosted we should mark goliath-xl v1 as \"requires 80GB+\" and default hosted max_context=49152 with an opt-in 65536 tier for Dedicated customers.
maria: action items: ajay -> PR with config + fallback rules; kevin -> full mem-floorplan gist with per-layer kv breakdown; sophie -> tokenizer preproc + unit test and note about CJK expansion; I'll gate staging rollout until we have kevin gist. locking canary until mem numbers live. :lock:
ajay: ack, PR started. adding test to strip pad tokens pre-send.
kevin: posting full gist: https://gist.github.com/rwd/abcd1234 (contains per-layer KV bytes, shard load timeline). TL;DR: enabling kv_shard_streaming reduces peak by ~12GB but increases latency tail.
sophie: noted. tradeoff is acceptable for hosted but for Dedicated customers we should expose both knobs and a perf profile.
maria: thanks team. will reconvene after kevin's final numbers; if streaming helps we can run a small canary in staging with kv_shard_streaming=true and max_ctx=65536. otherwise stick to 49152. :pray:
